name: New York City
sourceName: New York City Bike Routes, NYC DOT via NYC Open Data
where: status='Current' AND onoffst='ON' AND (ft_facilit='Protected' OR tf_facilit='Protected')
notes: Facility type is per direction (ft_/tf_facilit); onoffst='ON' drops off-street greenways that are also coded Protected.

name: San Francisco
sourceName: SFMTA Bikeway Network, SFMTA via DataSF
notes: Class IV is California's separated bikeway class. Dataset covers the existing network only.

name: Washington, DC
sourceName: Bicycle Lanes, DDOT via Open Data DC
notes: Protected lanes coded per side (BD both, IB inbound, OB outbound).

name: Chicago
sourceName: Bike Routes, CDOT via Chicago Data Portal
notes: Protected-lane field and values not yet confirmed

name: Boston
sourceName: Existing Bike Network, Boston Transportation Department via Analyze Boston
notes: Existing Facility codes don't clearly mark separated lanes (cycle-track codes match only 0.8 mi); left out until BTD confirms which ExisFacil codes are protected.

name: Seattle
sourceName: Existing Bike Facilities, SDOT via Seattle GeoData
notes: BKF-PBL is SDOT's protected bike lane category; in-service segments only.

name: Portland
sourceName: Bicycle Network, Portland Bureau of Transportation via PortlandMaps Open Data
notes: PBL = Protected Bike Lane, SIR = Separated in-Roadway; active segments only.

name: Philadelphia
sourceName: Philadelphia Bike Network 2024, City of Philadelphia (OTIS) via ArcGIS Online
where: BikewayTyp IN ('On-Street Separated Bike Lane','Raised Separated Bike Lane')
notes: On-street and raised separated bike lanes from the 2024 network layer.

name: Minneapolis
sourceName: Existing Bikeways, City of Minneapolis Public Works via ArcGIS Online
where: TYPE_1='On-Street Protected Bike Lane' OR TYPE_2='On-Street Protected Bike Lane'
notes: Segments whose primary or secondary type is On-Street Protected Bike Lane.

name: Los Angeles
sourceName: Bikeways (Existing), LADOT via City of Los Angeles GeoHub
